MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The reusable cable straps fit my Ethernet cables, cable covers, and cable ties: I am keeping my setup tidy while making it easier to rearrange connections.",
    "The surge protector feels useful because my computer and accessories need organized power connections alongside the cable cleanup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The fan, SSD, and DDR3 memory assume I am upgrading computer components, but my recent choices do not show a specific upgrade need or establish compatibility.",
    "The Mini HDMI cable requires a connector and length I have not shown a need for; owning an HDMI cable does not make every HDMI variant useful.",
    "Another keyboard feels redundant, surround speakers do not fit my current headphone setup, and neither UPS addresses an immediate battery-backup need. The discontinued products also give me pause."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into a general desire for computer parts and larger equipment.",
    "Previous keyboard, audio, and cable purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy more similar products without considering what those purchases already cover."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet cables, headphone mount, and cleaning equipment suggest practical improvements to an existing setup, rather than a new computer build.",
    "The purpose and compatibility of each accessory matter to me: reusable cable straps solve a clear problem, while specialized connectors and internal components require a specific need.",
    "I buy equipment for different purposes, including a Raspberry Pi, laptop, and GPS, so those purchases do not necessarily belong to one upgrade project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in improving my setup, but stretched that into equipment upgrades when cable organization and practical finishing touches fit better right now."
}
